git.note: the scripts listed above are not in this git repository (they live under fixcmp1016); md5 identifies them

source.map_definition: per member: TN X-Y (K); DEN, NE 100 (X-Y)/Y (%), on fixed heights by fixcmp_pairs.at_height() on each column's own ZG (TN linear, DEN NE linear in log; a column gives no value where it does not reach the height); mean over members only where all members have a value (batch2/figs.py map_task)
source.ht_definition: per member and time (decomp.pair_rows = scan.task, area weights cos(lat), points both X and Y reach): dom = difference of the global means (ratio_d: 100 (mean X - mean Y)/mean Y for positive fields; mean_d in K or m/s for TN UN VN); typ = rms of the pointwise difference (TN UN VN) or that rms / global mean of Y in % (others, norm_rms); cov = cov_xy. Over members: mean, min, max of dom; mean of typ; mean of cov; NaN unless all members have a value. Not cut at 50 % coverage (cov is given).
source.update: Re-export of 2026-11-04: adds comparisons N-D, N1-D, N-N1, N1-Ap and the quantities hmF2, NmF2 (peak of NE on model levels in each column, member by member) for all 18 comparisons. The original 14 comparisons are unchanged.
source.update3: Re-export of 2026-11-06: hmF2/NmF2 recomputed with the search limited to levels at or above 200 km (all pairs); assimilation-minus-control pairs exp6-ctrl95, v3exp1-v3ctrl, v3exp1_duff-v3ctrl_duff added (1-hour forecasts, members matched one to one; 7/5 00, 7/8 23 and 7/9 00 UT not available).
source.update4: fields themselves (maps_own_*, ht_own_*) for 16 configurations and 6 DART runs, from adhoc/20261106_web_export3 part c (results repo commit 8e880ed); DEN converted to kg m-3

time.note: time_code = DOY*100 + UT hour (2022); 7/5 00 UT is the spin-up file frame (186,0) (the continuation file also has a (186,0) frame, but its DEN and ZG are all fill, so it cannot be interpolated; its TN and NE equal the spin-up frame), the rest continuation files

configs.G1: D, cpktkm by mass mixing ratio
configs.H: 2.0, mbar with He/4 in dt.F and duv.F

kp.source: gpi_1960001-2023172.nc (variable kp, year_day 2022180-2022190; same as the time-series figures, figs.kp_series)
kp.note: 3-hourly; value at time t covers t to t+3 h (bars drawn from t in the figures)

grace.definition: ascending node to ascending node (~95 min), orbits with < 30 records skipped; nanmean of the along-track values; model = 10-member mean sampled at each record as grace_validate_v4 (copied from batch2/figs.py grace())
grace.ap_note: A' has no grace_model file; its values here are A's (decision of 10/19). A' and A are the same machine code; their single-precision secondary output is identical except at a few points in the last bit: measured 10/19 on cont frames (186,1), (188,18), (189,22), 10 members, TN O2 O1 HE Z ZG DEN NE: TN O2 HE Z ZG DEN identical; NE differs at 1-2 of 590976 points (relative 7e-8) in 9-10 members; O1 at 1 point (relative 8.4e-8) in member 7 at (189,22). Report docs/fixcmp_20261016.md section 10: A'-A on the secondary files is 0 for TN400, DEN300/400/500 in all segments.

peak_definition: hmF2/NmF2 (re-export of 2026-11-06): per member and column, the largest Ne over the model levels with geometric height >= 200 km; no HMF2/NMF2 field of the files is used.

own.definition: 10-member mean of the field itself at fixed heights (hmF2/NmF2: peak over levels at or above 200 km); maps_own encode value = lo + code*scale, or 10^(lo + code*scale) for the log fields; code 255 = no value. Height-time: area-weighted global mean, min and max of the member-mean field over the covered grid points, and coverage (%) of the globe; DEN in kg m-3.
